title: Implicit Beliefs as Scalable Process Rewards for Strategic Persuasion
abstract: arXiv:2610.33527v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Training large language models (LLMs) for multi-turn strategic persuasion faces two coupled obstacles: (i) realistic simulation of psychologically grounded persuadees, and (ii) dense, faithful supervision for credit assignment in strategic dialogues. Outcome-only rewards are sparse and uninformative about which conversational moves drove success, while LLM-judge process rewards are expensive and decoupled from the underlying interaction dynamics. We address both challenges with a unified framework. First, we introduce PersuArena, a persuasion simulation environment that produces realistic, non-monotonic trajectories. Second, building directly on this environment, we propose Process Rewards via Online Belief Elicitation for Relative Policy Optimization (Probe-RPO), an online RL framework that converts the persuadee's internal state into dense process rewards. translated_title: 隐性信念作为战略说服的可扩展过程奖励
translated_abstract: 训练大语言模型（LLM）进行多轮战略说服面临两个相互耦合的障碍：（一）对具有心理学基础的被说服者进行逼真模拟，（二）在战略对话中为信用分配提供密集且忠实的监督信号。仅基于最终结果的奖励是稀疏的，无法说明是哪些对话举动促成了成功；而基于LLM裁判的过程奖励则成本高昂，且与底层交互动态脱节。我们用一个统一框架来应对这两个挑战。首先，我们提出了PersuArena，一个能够产生逼真的、非单调轨迹的说服模拟环境。其次，直接构建在该环境之上，我们提出了Probe-RPO（通过在线信念引出实现相对策略优化的过程奖励），这是一个在线强化学习框架，能够将被说服者的内部状态转化为密集的过程奖励。在每一轮对话中，系统从冻结的被说服者内部状态读取三个内省探测信号……（摘要原文截断）
tldr: 该论文提出PersuArena说服模拟环境和Probe-RPO在线强化学习框架，通过将冻结的被说服者的隐性内部信念转化为密集的过程奖励，解决了大语言模型多轮战略说服训练中模拟真实性不足和信用分配监督稀疏的两大难题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces PersuArena, a realistic persuasion simulation environment, and Probe-RPO, an online RL framework that converts the frozen persuadee's implicit internal beliefs into dense process rewards, addressing the coupled challenges of realistic persuadee simulation and faithful credit assignment in training LLMs for multi-turn strategic persuasion.
